security_scope: Real Bulletproofs/Ed25519, adapted synthetic issuance, linkable presentations, local simulated authorization

cold_and_issuance.note: Five sequential case initializations; only the first includes lazy parameter setup. Not five independent cold processes.

public_parameter_reuse.scope: One before/after campaign on one machine; not a universal speedup or external scientific record

a.quantile_convention: nearest-rank: sorted[ceil(p * n) - 1], one-based rank ceil(p*n)
a.confidence_method: distribution-free binomial order-statistic interval, equal tail caps

confidence_assumptions.ties: conservative coverage for population quantile inf{x:F(x)>=p}
confidence_assumptions.arithmetic: IEEE-754 double recurrence; not certified numerical bounds
confidence_assumptions.interpretation: conditional on IID; not a service SLA or a maximum-latency bound
confidence_assumptions.null_endpoints: lower null means -Infinity; upper null means +Infinity
